mathematics.assertion_tested: Variation of the exponential AQUAL action gives the exact target constitutive law; its constant-external-field linearization yields the stated first-order point-source node specialization and the boundary-matched uniform-sphere harmonic clock tensor.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic expressions over the real field where possible; IEEE-754 binary64 for ellipsoid quadrature and deterministic SciPy DOP853 trajectories.
mathematics.conventions: +z is the external-field direction; prograde is +phi in a right-handed frame; i is measured from +z; omega is measured from the ascending node; node shift is the osculating angular-momentum-node change from one periapsis to the next; q=1+L_e and epsilon_e=L_e/q.
inputs: orbit audit geometry e=0.3, i=20 degrees, omega=40 degrees
controlled orbit eta=6 and finite-anisotropy orbit eta=2.47812944

bounds.field_regime: eta>0 and max(g_int/g_ext)<<1; eta=0 retained only as a one-sided ratio limit
bounds.secular_order: first order in epsilon_e; untruncated e,i,omega dependence at that order
bounds.eccentricity: 0<=e<1 with epsilon_e/sqrt(1-e^2)<<1 for uniform perturbative control
bounds.orbit_solver: DOP853 rtol=2e-12, atol=2e-14, max_step=0.03; refined max_step=0.015, rtol=5e-13, atol=5e-15
